tools.name: list_stock_tokens
tools.description: List every token in a chain's issuer registry: symbol, name, contract address, ISIN, multiplier, whether it is minted on the chain and whether the issuer publishes a reference price. The answer opens with the exact count (also the `count` field); quote that number, do not estimate it from the list.

tools.description: Check one token contract address in depth. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_anchor, address_on_date · Private data: find_stock_token, list_stock_tokens, stock_passport, verify_stock_tokens, recent_impostors, verify_anchor, largest_gaps, data_freshness, simulate_buy · Public sink: compare_venues, largest_gaps · Destructive: simulate_buy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_anchor, address_on_date · Private data: find_stock_token, list_stock_tokens, stock_passport, verify_stock_tokens, recent_impostors, verify_anchor, largest_gaps, data_freshness, simulate_buy · Public sink: compare_venues, largest_gaps · Destructive: simulate_buy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
